{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"An online text-based role playing game is a role-playing game played online using a solely text-based interface.","title":"Online text-based role-playing game"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Online text-based role playing games date to 1978, with the creation of \"MUD1\", which began the MUD heritage that culminates in today's MMORPGs.","title":"Online text-based role-playing game"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Some online-text based role playing games are video games, but some are organized and played entirely by humans through text-based communication.","title":"Online text-based role-playing game"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Over the years, games have used TELNET, internet forums, IRC, email and social networking websites as their media.","title":"Online text-based role-playing game"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Haven: City of Violence is a role-playing game created by Louis Porter Jr.","title":"Haven: City of Violence"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Design.","title":"Haven: City of Violence"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The game is a neo-noir \"role playing game of hyperkinetic action\" and was released for sale in 2003.","title":"Haven: City of Violence"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" \"Haven: City of Violence\" is the first role-playing game ever to be optioned by a movie production company prior to its public release.","title":"Haven: City of Violence"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" Louis Porter Jr. and his company began working on the game in 1998.","title":"Haven: City of Violence"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" They had been developing it for six years when Barry Levine's company, Brigade Entertainment, optioned the movie rights for the game.","title":"Haven: City of Violence"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"What was the name of the founder and president of the company which produced the role playing game FTL:2448?"}
